description: This source file defines the FrameFilter class, a specific frame processor in the Pipecat framework that filters frames based on their types, allowing only specified frame types to pass through the processing pipeline, while ensuring system and end frames are always passed.

classes.name: FrameFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that filters frames based on their types, inheriting from FrameProcessor and limiting pass-through to specified frame types and always passing system/end frames.

methods.name: __init__(self, types: Tuple[Type[Frame], ...])
methods.description: Initializes the FrameFilter with a tuple of allowed frame types.

methods.name: _should_passthrough_frame(self, frame)
methods.description: Determines if a given frame should pass through based on its type or if it is a system/end frame.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a frame, passing it through if it meets criteria.
